function.name: Read
function.description: Read a bounded section of a text file within the workspace.

offset.description: 1-indexed line to start at; defaults to 1.

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to return; defaults to 500.

function.name: Glob
function.description: Find non-hidden, non-Git-ignored workspace paths matching a glob pattern.

pattern.description: Workspace-relative glob pattern, such as src/**/*.go.

function.name: Grep
function.description: Search non-hidden, non-Git-ignored workspace text files with a regular expression.

function.name: GitStatus
function.description: Show the workspace Git branch and short working-tree status.

function.name: GitDiff
function.description: Show a bounded read-only Git diff for the workspace. Use revisionRange to compare commits or branches; staged and revisionRange cannot be combined. Use a base named by the user, and ask if the intended base is unclear.

staged.description: Show the staged diff instead of the working-tree diff.

revisionRange.description: Validated Git range with two commit revisions, such as main...HEAD or base..HEAD. Must not be combined with staged=true.

function.name: GitLog
function.description: Show recent one-line Git history, optionally limited to a path.

maxCount.description: Maximum commits to return; defaults to 20.

function.name: GitShow
function.description: Show a Git revision, optionally limited to a workspace path.

revision.description: Git revision, such as HEAD or a commit hash.

function.name: Doc
function.description: Look up offline language and package documentation using the installed doc script. Use for API signatures and version-specific local docs. Results are bounded; unavailable operations return an error. Python show and Python/Node members are excluded because they import package code.

action.description: List standard libraries, list members, show an entry, or search documentation.

entry.description: Package, module, or class for members/show.

scope.description: Search scope; defaults to std. TypeScript search uses project. List supports std only.
